الالتزام بالمواصفات الفنية السليمة في عمل الوصلة نظرا لتعرضها لقوي شد قد 
تؤثر على متانتها وبالتالي تعرض الأفراد لمخاطر قطع الموصلات وسقوطها بشكل عشوائي

في حالة وجود مساعد 
 أسفل البرج يراعي عدم 
 وقوفه أسفل البرج مباشرة حرصا على عدم 
 سقوط أي من الأدوات عليه

يراعي عمل ارضي موضعي على طرفي الموصل 
 أمام الشداد زيادة في الحرص على 
 أمان 
 القائم بعمل الوصلة في حالة سقوط موصل به جهد يمر 
 أعلى الخط الذي يتم عمل 
 الوصلة عليه أو تلافي التشاحن بين خطوط الجهد الفائق والخط الذي يتم عمل الوصلة 
 عليه

، مبين جهد

طقم لقم (بمقاسات مختلفة ومناسبة

طقم مفكات بمقاسات مختلفة ، طقم مفاتيح (بلدي مشرر) 
 ، زردية أو بنسة لفك اكسسوارات العازلات

كلمبات ، كلابة 
 Grip
 ، حبل ،

مكبس 
 ، مسامير قلاووظ بالورد للتثبيت

مقص حدادي ، شحم كهربي

 أدوات للتنظيف قبل الكبس (كهنة)

rows: Maintenance Procedures Information System
Overhead Lines
Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: TL-044-r0a
Equipment: Medium-voltage overhead lines
Issued to: Distribution Companies
Status: Approved
Approval date: 12 February 2006
Procedure: Fitting the bridle joint
Next review date: February 2011

sections_en.text: This document sets out the steps for fitting the bridle joint on medium-voltage lines. It was prepared by the Minya Electricity Distribution Sector, Middle Egypt Electricity Distribution Company, and discussed, amended and approved by the MPIS coordinators of the electricity distribution companies.

rows: Issue a work permit and a work order, with the workers on site carrying an occupational safety and health category card.
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs.
The occupational safety and health equipment must be used.
Take care to wear the safety belt and fix it well to the tower, observing the appropriate clearance for freedom of movement.
Make sure both sources of supply are disconnected from the line to be worked on and that it is earthed from both sides, and earthed before and after the joint work area.
Make sure the tools used for making the joint are sound before starting work (rope, press, grips, ferrules, steel cutter, pulleys).

Observe the correct technical specifications when making the joint, since it is exposed to tensile forces that may affect its strength and consequently expose personnel to the risk of conductors breaking and falling randomly.
If there is an assistant below the tower, he must not stand directly below the tower, to avoid any tool falling on him.

Fit a local earth on both ends of the conductor ahead of the stay, as an extra precaution for the safety of the person making the joint, in case a live conductor falls and passes above the line on which the joint is being made, or to avoid charging between the extra high voltage lines and the line on which the joint is being made.
Portable earth, voltage indicator.
Occupational safety and health equipment such as a safety helmet and safety belt, etc.
Aluminium ferrules of different sizes.
Aluminium lugs of different sizes, copper lugs of different sizes in the case of copper wire.
Die set (of different sizes suitable for the lug cross-sectional area), ratchet.
Screwdriver set of different sizes, spanner set (open-end and ring), pliers for removing insulator accessories.
Clamps, grip, rope, a set of pulleys for pulling the conductors.
Press, threaded bolts with washers for fixing.
Steel cutter, electrical grease, Vaseline, cleaning tools before compression (rags), cleaning material (caustic potash).

sections_en.text: Procedures to be Carried Out, carried out on top of the tension tower (Figure No. 1)

rows: Remove the excess length of the two conductor ends so that the bridle is of a suitable length.
Clean the two conductor ends to be compressed inside the joint, applying Vaseline.

Insert the conductor end inside the cylindrical ferrule, taking care to rotate the ferrule in the same direction as the lay of the conductor so that it reaches the middle of the distance between the two ends of the ferrule.
Insert the second conductor end inside the ferrule, taking care to rotate the conductor in the same direction as the lay.
Compress with (2) compressions for each conductor end inside the ferrule, starting compression from the inside outwards.

Introduction
This document sets out the steps for fitting the bridle joint on medium-voltage lines. It was prepared by the Minya Electricity Distribution Sector, Middle Egypt Electricity Distribution Company, and discussed, amended and approved by the MPIS coordinators of the electricity distribution companies.
Safety Precautions
Issue a work permit and a work order, with the workers on site carrying an occupational safety and health category card. | 
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs. | 
The occupational safety and health equipment must be used. | 
Take care to wear the safety belt and fix it well to the tower, observing the appropriate clearance for freedom of movement. | 
Make sure both sources of supply are disconnected from the line to be worked on and that it is earthed from both sides, and earthed before and after the joint work area. | 
Make sure the tools used for making the joint are sound before starting work (rope, press, grips, ferrules, steel cutter, pulleys). | 
Observe the correct technical specifications when making the joint, since it is exposed to tensile forces that may affect its strength and consequently expose personnel to the risk of conductors breaking and falling randomly. | 
If there is an assistant below the tower, he must not stand directly below the tower, to avoid any tool falling on him. | 
Fit a local earth on both ends of the conductor ahead of the stay, as an extra precaution for the safety of the person making the joint, in case a live conductor falls and passes above the line on which the joint is being made, or to avoid charging between the extra high voltage lines and the line on which the joint is being made. | 
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Portable earth, voltage indicator. | 
Occupational safety and health equipment such as a safety helmet and safety belt, etc. | 
Aluminium ferrules of different sizes. | 
Aluminium lugs of different sizes, copper lugs of different sizes in the case of copper wire. | 
Die set (of different sizes suitable for the lug cross-sectional area), ratchet. | 
Screwdriver set of different sizes, spanner set (open-end and ring), pliers for removing insulator accessories. | 
Clamps, grip, rope, a set of pulleys for pulling the conductors. | 
Press, threaded bolts with washers for fixing. | 
Steel cutter, electrical grease, Vaseline, cleaning tools before compression (rags), cleaning material (caustic potash). | 
Procedures to be Carried Out, carried out on top of the tension tower (Figure No. 1)
Remove the excess length of the two conductor ends so that the bridle is of a suitable length. | 1.
Clean the two conductor ends to be compressed inside the joint, applying Vaseline. | 2.
Insert the conductor end inside the cylindrical ferrule, taking care to rotate the ferrule in the same direction as the lay of the conductor so that it reaches the middle of the distance between the two ends of the ferrule. | 3.
Insert the second conductor end inside the ferrule, taking care to rotate the conductor in the same direction as the lay. | 4.
Compress with (2) compressions for each conductor end inside the ferrule, starting compression from the inside outwards. | 5.
